accountDeleted: Your account has been deleted. Thanks for playing.
confirmEmailBody: We sent a link to {{email}}. Click it, come back and sign in — your first deck is waiting.

err.emailNotConfirmed: Email not confirmed yet — check your inbox.
err.emailTaken: This email is already registered. Sign in or use another one.
err.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
err.oauthFailed: Google / Facebook sign-in failed. Please try again.
err.pwTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
err.pwWeak: Password is too weak. Use at least 8 characters.
err.registerFailed: Registration error. Try again — the account was not created.

fp.body: Enter your email — we'll send you a recovery link.
fp.sentBody: If such a user exists, you'll find a recovery link in your inbox. Clicking it brings you back to the Ravenof Digital sign-in.
fp.title: PASSWORD RECOVERY

guest.confirmBody: We sent an email to {{email}}. Enter the code from it, or open the link in the email and then tap “I've confirmed”.
guest.errCode: That code is wrong or has expired.
guest.errDisabled: Guest mode is currently unavailable. Please create an account.
guest.errFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
guest.errNotConfirmed: Your email is not confirmed yet. Open the link in the email or enter the code.
guest.hint: No sign-up needed. You can create an account later in Settings and keep your progress.
guest.label: Guest account
guest.logoutWarn: Guest progress will be lost – create an account in Settings first.
guest.upgradeBody: You are playing as a guest – your progress is stored on this device only. Add an email and password to sign in from anywhere.

intro: Dark-fantasy card battles: 8 factions, living spells, curses and graveyard magic. The deck you choose becomes your first weapon.
oauthWaiting: Sign in in the browser window that opened – the game continues automatically when you return.
tagline: Pick your name. Claim your first deck. Step into Ravenof.
termsNote: By continuing you agree to the game rules.
